claims.how: Phidippus johnsoni principal eyes resolve about 3.8 cycles per degree, from an inter-receptor angle of 0.13 degrees.
Metaphidippus side eyes cover almost 360 degrees and the family is given as 360 degrees, so 280 is an invented value set below the full circle to leave the front narrow; graded g and invented.

quotes.quote: with more typical species (e.g., *Phidippus johnsoni*) having eyes that support visual angles of around 0.13 degrees
the side eyes between them cover almost the entire 3600 around the animal in the horizontal plane
Combined, the four pairs of eyes give the spider a 360° field of view.
